scope: Layout model and injected DOM input events; no browser pixels, OS drag or EXE/Meta validation
checks: Default workspace gives preview most left height and puts Console/CLI in one short dock
All four edge placements preserve panels once and can merge back into tabs
Moving a last panel prunes empty splits, self-drop does not remove it
Workspace edge docking makes a full-height independent CLI column
Floating groups can split, merge, close and reopen without losing panels
Invalid and duplicate saved states are rejected
Repeated moves remain valid across floating/docking and serialize faithfully
Renderer starts with four unequal dock groups and five movable tabs
Native drag event route docks a tab at the right edge and shows a drop guide
Draft and graph selection survive docking, floating, close and reopen
Pointer drop at the outer workspace edge splits the whole workspace
Floating move and resize respond to pointer events
Splitter pointer and keyboard updates are persisted
Collapse, double-click maximize and Escape restore preserve arrangement
Keyboard-accessible move dialog rearranges without drag
Saved layout and reload restore structure; malformed storage resets safely
Search and explicit sample chat input work without sending any request
